text:
amy_sales: :wave: Hey team — POC kickoff with AcmeCorp next Mon. Need help provisioning a POC environment they can validate for security and billing. Request: hosted API keys (ephemeral), a small Dedicated pool for load testing (prefers 1xA100), and an option for a VPC-enabled Private trial if they ask. Also need a billing project with spend cap $2,000 and $500 free credits, separate quota from their prod org. I attached the security questionnaire in the ticket. Can we coordinate?
raj_solutions: noted. What's their expected QPS and model family? helps decide pool size and whether to give prefix caching.
lina_eng: @amy_sales can you confirm model and sequence length? if they're testing chat gen on a 4k seq we should reserve a medium instance, otherwise a single A100 should be fine. also which region for VPC (us-west-2 preferred)?
amy_sales: they want Llama2-like open weights (llama-2-13b-ish) for evals, median seq ~1024, peak 2048. Region: us-west-2. Expected burst ~30 concurrent requests but mostly spike testing.
lina_eng: OK reserving 1xA100 dedicated pool with autoscale disabled (we'll keep it steady for consistent latency). If they escalate to private, we'll handoff network details to infra.
mike_finance: finance/process note: we can't set spend cap at the org level for enterprise customers, but we can create a billing project named "acme-poc-1876" with a hard budget alert at $2,000 and preload $500 in promo credits. For strict spend ceilings, we can issue ephemeral billing keys and require app-level quota enforcement. If you want a hard block at $2k, we need legal signoff (enterprise billing constraint).
amy_sales: promo credits + budget alert is fine for now. Please add ephemeral API keys that expire after 14 days. Also need quotas: 100k tokens/day.
mike_finance: understood. I'll create the billing project and preload credits. Steps I'm about to run (internal):
```
# internal command - do not share
rctl billing create --project acme-poc-1876 --org AcmeCorp --budget 2000 --promo 500 --quota tokens:100000/day
rctl keys create --project acme-poc-1876 --type ephemeral --expiry 14d
```
I'll post confirmation once done.
deploy-bot: Reserved dedicated pool: pool-id dp-ACME-1876, instance: 1xA100, region: us-west-2, autoscale: off, window: 2026-04-06T08:00Z -> 2026-04-20T08:00Z :white_check_mark:
sara_se: I picked up the security questionnaire. Quick wins: SSO requirement -> we can provide SAML metadata and a hosted signing key; Data residency -> confirm logs scrub PII and KMS integration available. I'll upload completed answers to the ticket and cc legal.
raj_solutions: for the ephemeral keys, add a note on usage patterns and a sample SDK snippet for rotating keys. helps them do the integration quickly.
amy_sales: yes please — can we also create a tiny demo workspace with example prompts so they can sanity-check outputs before ramping?
lina_eng: will push a quickstart repo and a minimal prompt set to the project. hooking KV cache + prefix caching off by default so their quality evals are deterministic.
mike_finance: billing project created and credits applied. Project ID: acme-poc-1876. Ephemeral key created: sent via secure ticket. Budget alert set at $1,800 & $2,000 (warning + hard notify).
amy_sales: amazing — thank you all. I'll share access with Acme SRE and schedule a 30m handoff on Friday.
sara_se: security Q uploaded, SAML metadata attached. If they want private/VPC next, we can start a scoping call.
amy_sales: perfect. tagging this thread for the Friday sync. :thumbsup:
